5.karmaPos: Your destiny is linked to spirituality, learning, and passing on knowledge. You can create courses, lead educational projects, and become a mentor to others. Through teaching you fulfill your purpose.
5.karmaNeg: Relationships with your father and mentors shape your life direction. Even if your dad is difficult, respect and support are essential, otherwise you may face difficulties with men and authority. There is also a risk of falling under false teachers, so it is important to be careful in choosing whom to follow.
